designChallenge: Typography and reading. There is almost no interface here, one image, and 1,200 words that someone has to actually want to read. Success is measured in reading comfort and voice, not in mechanisms. A skill that only knows how to add motion has nothing to grab onto.
prompt: This is a single long-form essay on The Marginal, an independent publication about archives and records. It is currently set in plain default type. Redesign the reading experience so it is genuinely distinctive and worth shipping.
preserve: The full essay text — every section heading and every paragraph, unabridged
The headline, standfirst, and byline with date and read time
The lede image and its caption
All three footnotes in the Notes section
The three related articles with titles, descriptions, and read times
The subscribe form with email field and its success state
